error.FORBIDDEN: Only owners, admins, instructors and reviewers can review written answers.
error.SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: You cannot review your own answer. Ask another reviewer.
error.RUBRIC_QUOTE_REQUIRED: Every criterion marked as met needs an exact quotation (10+ characters) from the learner's answer.
error.RUBRIC_CRITERIA_INCOMPLETE: Record a finding for every criterion.
error.RUBRIC_DECISION_INCONSISTENT: The decision must match the findings: met only when every required criterion is met.
error.CLARIFICATION_NOTE_REQUIRED: Write a note telling the learner what to clarify.
error.ALREADY_REVIEWED: This answer was already reviewed. Refresh the queue.
error.RUBRIC_CHANGED: The rubric changed after this answer was submitted; it cannot be reviewed under the new rubric.
error.RUBRIC_ASSIST_CONSENT_REQUIRED: The learner has not allowed AI drafts for their written answers.
error.RUBRIC_ASSIST_UNAVAILABLE: No reviewer-drafts model is configured for this workspace.
error.SECOND_REVIEWER_REQUIRED: A different reviewer must give the second opinion.
error.APPEAL_ALREADY_DECIDED: This appeal was already decided. Refresh the queue.
error.PROBE_ONLY_FOR_CLARIFICATION: Only a clarification request can be marked as a neutral question.
error.RUBRIC_SUGGESTION_MISMATCH: That draft belongs to a different answer. Refresh the queue.
error.fallback: The review could not be saved. Nothing changed.
